description: OpenCode providers phase 1 contract shared by hgs, the Rust connector, the desktop, Android and iOS; regenerate with tests/fixtures/opencode-provider-catalog.py. service holds raw OpenCode 2.0.32-shaped responses that deliberately carry secrets; favorites is the stored favorites list; row is what hgs adds to the native-opencode account row for the home location; hgs_account is that complete row as the connector reads it; heartbeat_account and launch_account are the connector projections of hgs_account; stopped_account is a truncated row of a stopped service; ascii_lengths pins len(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=True)), the measure of the 32 KiB row budget and the 128 KiB projection.

stopped_account.label: Native OpenCode configuration
stopped_account.catalog_reason: OpenCode is not running on fixture

stopped_hgs_account.label: Native OpenCode configuration
stopped_hgs_account.catalog_reason: OpenCode is not running on fixture

account_models.description: hgs account models for a project folder. service holds the raw answers for that location (the home answers are the top-level service: workspace is listed only here); answer is the complete hgs output with catalog_at fixed.
